images.alt: A satin ribbon runs from a night sky into daybreak, with paper leaves unfolding along it.
images.source: A wide landscape of flat faceted paper hills under a sky that runs from deep Partner Navy night at the right to pale daybreak at the upper left. A satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan flows out of the dark side toward the light, and small faceted paper leaves unfold along it, larger and brighter as they reach the dawn: work that moves forward overnight and is ready by morning. Calm sky in the upper left quarter. Portrait, about 8:9, safe to crop to 4:5. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

faq.a: In the Philippines. We work while you sleep: brief us before you log off, and you’ll see progress when you log on.
AI takes over the repetitive hours, and a person still reviews every piece of work before it reaches you.

You see progress every week, a person reviews every piece of work, and your data stays in your systems wherever possible. The Philippines also has a national privacy law, enforced by an independent National Privacy Commission.
It stays where you decide, and we never use it to train anything you don’t own. Our data and security page explains how we handle it.

notes: Hero tagline from Brand DNA section 7 (US ads, sales emails). The FTC substantiation rule is an internal check, so it is not mentioned on the page; price comparisons still need checking before any ad runs. Every promise on the page is Brand DNA wording: the five price promises are verbatim from 'Our honest pricing promise' (confirm each is true before launch), the price card line is the Brand DNA's embedded-developers line, and the FAQ answers are the Brand DNA's 'Questions buyers will ask'. Header marks no nav item. One Primary in the hero and one in the closing band. Every number carries a Source key and a dated source line in its own section.
